rationale: Tests that a complete, low-risk plumbing job is neither flagged into ambiguity nor escalated to professional confirmation it does not need.
quote_text:
Brookfield Plumbing - Quotation BP-1187
Property: 4 Ashcombe Row
Date of survey: 09 May. Surveyed by: R. Fenton.

Work requested by customer: dripping basin tap in the main bathroom, and a stiff
isolation valve under the same basin.

Survey findings: basin mixer cartridge worn, tap body pitted at the base. Isolation
valve seized in the open position.

Quoted work:
  1. Supply and fit Ravensworth RX2 basin mixer tap, chrome, 1 no.        Rs. 3,400
     (Customer may supply their own tap; deduct Rs. 3,400 if so.)
  2. Supply and fit 15 mm compression isolation valve, 1 no.              Rs.   280
  3. Flexible tap connectors, 15 mm x 300 mm, 2 nos.                      Rs.   240
  4. Labour, 1 hour 30 minutes at Rs. 700 per hour                        Rs. 1,050
                                                                          ---------
  Total                                                                   Rs. 4,970

Water will be off to the bathroom for approximately 45 minutes.
Tap carries a 5 year manufacturer warranty on the cartridge; our workmanship is
warranted for 12 months.
Quotation valid 30 days. No advance payment required.

should_identify: A survey was carried out and the findings are stated, so each item has a reason attached.
The customer-supplied-tap option and its exact deduction are stated, which is unusually clear.
Quantities, sizes, unit prices, labour rate and duration, warranties, and validity are all present.
must_not_invent: Hidden charges, missing scope, or a need for further diagnosis. None is present.
A recommendation to have this checked by another professional. It is a routine tap and valve swap, fully specified and surveyed.
semantic_expectations.notes: The plumbing_home clean case, and one of the three professional_confirmation_not_expected cases. A model that escalates this quote is producing noise, not caution (rubric dimension 6).
